gitCommit.subject: feat: audit log for permanent purges (table + atomic item-purge write + owner read) — purses-ite (#217)
gitCommit.body:
feat: audit log for permanent purges (table + atomic item-purge write + owner read) — purses-ite (#217)

* docs(spec): audit-log design rev-2 (adversarial spec review folded — purses-ite)

Permanent-purge audit log: audit_log table + AuditLogRepository + atomic
item-purge write + owner-scoped read endpoint. Data/Security/Architect+QA
spec review (all CONCERNS) folded: tx-bound-by-construction (no optional-tx
footgun), named atomicity injection, .returning().length count, literal-union
types, exact ?limit= clamp, total sort order, IDOR/existence-oracle tests.

* docs(plan): audit-log implementation plan (5 tasks, TDD) — purses-ite

* feat(db): audit_log table + AuditLog types (append-only purge trail) — purses-ite

* feat(repo): AuditLogRepository — record + findByCollection (clamped, total order) — purses-ite

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(items): item purge writes an atomic audit_log entry (purses-ite)

* feat(api): GET /api/collections/[id]/audit — owner-only purge trail (purses-ite)

Owner-only read of a collection's permanent-purge audit trail. Reuses
requireApiCollectionOwner (404 absent before 403 not-owner) and
AuditLogRepository.findByCollection (clamps limit). Un-mocked integration
tests drive the real route against ephemeral Postgres: owner 200 newest-first,
non-owner member 403, stranger-on-foreign-collection 403, absent id 404,
empty collection 200 [], hostile ?limit clamped (never 500), unauth 401.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: audit_log table + GET /api/collections/[id]/audit + item-purge audit write (purses-ite)

* test(audit): pure-unit test pinning clampLimit cap constants (whole-branch review nit)

* chore(graphify): refresh
